claim: Reviewed static fact, not a run of vLLM's code: no file of vLLM's serving process (vllm/, csrc/, rust/) names HUGGINGFACE_HUB_CACHE; the result lists the files the scan read. The huggingface_hub library reads it when it is imported (huggingface_hub/constants.py:173 at huggingface_hub 2.0.0, the lowest version the pin's requirements/common.txt admits), as the default of HF_HUB_CACHE (constants.py:177-181), the directory model files are cached in. vLLM's two load-time uses of HF_HUB_CACHE are those of the HF_HUB_CACHE proof, so the variable only chooses where model files are looked for before the first request, and no step, admission or KV-budget decision of the engine follows from it.
